currentBudget_mA.note: Reserve rows are design allocations, not quoted IC specifications; CAN term load already included in transceiver ICC, not double-added.

supplyLimits.USB_VBUS: sense+ESD only; must never connect to V5 or V3V3
supplyLimits.no_external_backfeed: SWD and headers are reference outputs only; probe Vtarget must sense, not power; TLV755 has no reverse blocking
supplyLimits.current_budget_revision: Final normal150mA/Ta0-40C supersedes initial120mA/Ta0-50C after MCU50mA+CAN60mA+external10mA leaves no pullup margin. Fault180mA not normal guarantee.
supplyLimits.native_historical_L1_requirement: L1 saved REQUIREMENTS still says covers nominal120mA as original design context; not inductor current rating. Actual Isat5.8A/Irms4.5A unchanged and final150mA load/thermal review controls. No native rerun needed.

actualNetMetricsDefinition: Manual centerline sums include branches and are not a single supply current path. Existing full native DRC/graph is distinct from load/thermal/edge validity.

thermalArithmetic.scope: Only (5-3.3)*.150 arithmetic, excludes IQ, voltage/part tolerance and actual thermal resistance/temperature; not junction-temperature approval.
